# Data contracts of the official-news pack

One section per command of the pack: the shape of its data, how it is stored and checked, and what a person still has to confirm. The rules every contract shares are in [the contracts README](../README.md); the index of every command is [packs/README.md](README.md). The pack's guide, [config/packs/economy/official-news/guides/official-news.md](../../../config/packs/economy/official-news/guides/official-news.md), shows the same contracts (generated from the same files, tools/packgen/common/guide_data.py) next to how to use the pack and where each kind's data comes from (*Data retrieval*).

| Command | Kind | Class | Status | Fields | To review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [PRESS](#press-official-press-releases-release-source) | `release-source` | fundamental | active | 16 | 0 |
| [PREL](#prel-press-release-press-release) | `press-release` | fundamental | active | 13 | 0 |

## PRESS: Official press releases (`release-source`)

One publisher of official news (a central bank, a regulator, a government): its latest releases newest first, each a link, and its terms.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [release-source.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/economy/official-news/contracts/release-source.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | public data: Federal Reserve Board; European Central Bank; Bank of Canada; Bank of England; US Securities and Exchange Commission; OSFI; US Federal Register; Canada Gazette, Part II; Canada Gazette, Part I, pulled by the official-news feed (config/feeds/official-news.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per official press releases, keyed by SOURCE_ID. |
| Key | `SOURCE_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^PRESS-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the official-news feed's schedule (0 23 * * * UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Storage | connector `officialnews-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/officialnews/release-source/` |
| Test data | config/packs/economy/official-news/samples |
| Worked example | [official-news/release-source](../samples/official-news/release-source.md) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE_ID` | id | required |  | PRESS- and the publisher's id in the feed's YAML (FED, ECB, BOC, BOE, SEC, OSFI, FEDREG, GAZETTE1, GAZETTE2). | `PRESS-BOC` (pattern `^PRESS-`) |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The publisher's name. | `Bank of Canada` |  |
| `PUBLISHER_TYPE` | text | required |  | What the publisher is. | `central bank`, `regulator`, `government` |  |
| `COUNTRY` | text | required |  | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the publisher's country (EMU for the euro area). | `CAN` |  |
| `WEBSITE` | text | optional |  | The publisher's page of releases. | `https://www.bankofcanada.ca/press/press-releases/` |  |
| `FEED_URL` | text | required |  | The address the feed reads (RSS, Atom, or the Federal Register's API). | `https://www.bankofcanada.ca/content_type/press-releases/fee…` |  |
| `LICENCE` | text | required |  | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | `Bank of Canada terms of use: free to use, copy, distribute …` |  |
| `TERMS_URL` | text | optional |  | The publisher's terms page. | `https://www.bankofcanada.ca/terms/` |  |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required |  | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | `False` |  |
| `WHY_INTERNAL` | text | optional |  | Why the publisher's releases are internal only, in words; empty when they are not. | `The Bank of England allows personal and internal non-commer…` |  |
| `RELEASES` | integer | required |  | How many releases are kept (the last keep-days, at most keep-per-source). | `5` |  |
| `LAST_PUBLISHED` | timestamp | optional |  | When the newest kept release was published (UTC). | `2026-11-05T16:00:19Z` |  |
| `LAST_PULL` | text | required |  | ok, or failed (the kept releases are shown) when the publisher's feed could not be read. | `ok` |  |
| `LATEST` | record list | required |  | The newest 25 releases, newest first: PUBLISHED, TITLE, URL, CATEGORY and PRESS_RELEASE. |  |  |
| `BY_CATEGORY` | record list | required |  | The kept releases counted by category (CATEGORY, COUNT), the largest first. |  |  |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required |  | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |  |  |

**Nested `LATEST[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PUBLISHED` | timestamp | required |  | When the release was published (UTC). | `2026-11-05T16:00:19Z` |  |
| `TITLE` | text | required |  | The release's title. | `Joint Statement of the Government of Canada and the Bank of…` |  |
| `URL` | text | required |  | The release on the publisher's site. | `https://www.bankofcanada.ca/2026/11/joint-statement-of-the-…` |  |
| `CATEGORY` | text | optional |  | The publisher's category for it, where its feed gives one. | `Enforcement Actions` |  |
| `PRESS_RELEASE` | id | required |  | The release's page in Drishti (PREL-...). | `PREL-BOC-539E907647` (pattern `^PREL-`) | `press-release` |

**Nested `BY_CATEGORY[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CATEGORY` | text | required |  | The category, Uncategorised when the feed gives none. | `Uncategorised` |  |
| `COUNT` | integer | required |  | How many kept releases have that category. | `5` |  |

**Nested `PROVENANCE`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The publisher. | `Bank of Canada` |  |
| `DATASET` | text | required |  | The publisher's feed the record was read from. | `Bank of Canada: press releases` |  |
| `RETRIEVED_AT` | date | required |  | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | `2026-11-06` |  |
| `LICENCE` | text | required |  | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | `Bank of Canada terms of use: free to use, copy, distribute …` |  |
| `ATTRIBUTION` | text | required |  | The credit line to repeat when the release is shown or republished. | `Source: Bank of Canada.` |  |
| `URL` | text | required |  | The original on the publisher's site. | `https://www.bankofcanada.ca/press/press-releases/` |  |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required |  | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | `False` |  |

**Links:** `LATEST[].PRESS_RELEASE` → `press-release`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `SOURCE_ID`, `NAME`, `PUBLISHER_TYPE`, `COUNTRY`, `FEED_URL`, `LICENCE`, `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `RELEASES`, `LAST_PULL`, `LATEST`, `BY_CATEGORY`, `PROVENANCE`
- unique: key `SOURCE_ID`; per snapshot
- pattern: field SOURCE_ID; pattern ^PRESS-
- enum: field PUBLISHER_TYPE; values `central bank`, `regulator`, `government`
- link: field LATEST[].PRESS_RELEASE; kind press-release
- range: field BY_CATEGORY[].COUNT; min 0

**Notes**

- Stored in the newslake lake (config/lakes/newslake.yaml), table <data>/delta/newslake/officialnews/release-source/, one JSONL.gz a business date loaded with mode replace (a rerun of a day is idempotent).
- Delivered as JSON Lines: one document a line, UTF-8, gzipped, with a .ready file naming the lake, pack, kind, connector, business date, mode, key, sha256 and row count (DATA_LAKE_GUIDE.md section 4).

## PREL: Press release (`press-release`)

One official press release: its title, publisher, date, summary and the link to the original.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [press-release.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/economy/official-news/contracts/press-release.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | public data: Federal Reserve Board; European Central Bank; Bank of Canada; Bank of England; US Securities and Exchange Commission; OSFI; US Federal Register; Canada Gazette, Part II; Canada Gazette, Part I, pulled by the official-news feed (config/feeds/official-news.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per press release, keyed by RELEASE_ID. |
| Key | `RELEASE_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^PREL-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the official-news feed's schedule (0 23 * * * UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Storage | connector `officialnews-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/officialnews/press-release/` |
| Test data | config/packs/economy/official-news/samples |
| Worked example | [official-news/press-release](../samples/official-news/press-release.md) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RELEASE_ID` | id | required |  | PREL-, the publisher's id and the first ten hex digits of the SHA-1 of the release's address. | `PREL-FED-0224349908` (pattern `^PREL-`) |  |
| `TITLE` | text | required |  | The release's title as the publisher's feed gives it. | `Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement …` |  |
| `PUBLISHED` | timestamp | optional |  | When the release was published, in UTC. | `2026-11-05T16:00:00Z` |  |
| `DATE` | date | optional |  | The day it was published (UTC). | `2026-11-05` |  |
| `URL` | text | required |  | The release on the publisher's site: open it for the full text. | `https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/enf…` |  |
| `SUMMARY` | text | optional |  | The summary the publisher's feed gives, as plain text cut at 400 characters; empty when the feed gives none. | `Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement …` |  |
| `CATEGORY` | text | optional |  | The publisher's category (the Federal Register: the document type and agencies). | `Enforcement Actions` |  |
| `RELEASE_SOURCE` | id | required |  | The publisher's page (PRESS-<id>). | `PRESS-FED` (pattern `^PRESS-`) | `release-source` |
| `PUBLISHER_NAME` | text | required |  | The publisher's name. | `Federal Reserve Board` |  |
| `PUBLISHER_TYPE` | text | required |  | What the publisher is. | `central bank`, `regulator`, `government` |  |
| `COUNTRY` | text | required |  | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the publisher's country (EMU for the euro area). | `USA` |  |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required |  | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | `False` |  |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required |  | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |  |  |

**Nested `PROVENANCE`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The publisher. | `Federal Reserve Board` |  |
| `DATASET` | text | required |  | The publisher's feed the record was read from. | `Federal Reserve Board: press releases` |  |
| `RETRIEVED_AT` | date | required |  | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | `2026-11-06` |  |

**Links:** `RELEASE_SOURCE` → `release-source`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `RELEASE_ID`, `TITLE`, `URL`, `RELEASE_SOURCE`, `PUBLISHER_NAME`, `PUBLISHER_TYPE`, `COUNTRY`, `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `PROVENANCE`
- unique: key `RELEASE_ID`; per snapshot
- pattern: field RELEASE_ID; pattern ^PREL-
- link: field RELEASE_SOURCE; kind release-source
